Class SoilMechanicsEngine

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.simulation.SoilMechanicsEngine
public class SoilMechanicsEngine extends Object
Advanced Geomechanics Engine for Soil Stability, Mohr-Coulomb Rupture invalid input: '&' Arch Collapse. Simulates real-world soil cohesion, suction matrix, sand angle of repose, and maximum span calculation for excavated gallery ceilings.

    • computeShearStrength

      public static float computeShearStrength(TerrariumCell.Material material, float compactionIndex, float relativeHumidity)
      Evaluates Mohr-Coulomb shear strength tau = c' + (sigma - u_a) * tan(phi).
      Parameters:
      material - Soil substrate material type
      compactionIndex - Soil compaction percentage (10% to 100%)
      relativeHumidity - Relative soil moisture (0% to 100%)
      Returns:
      Effective shear strength in kPa

    • computeMaxGallerySpanMm

      public static float computeMaxGallerySpanMm(TerrariumCell.Material material, float compactionIndex, float relativeHumidity)
      Calculates the maximum stable span S_max for an excavated gallery ceiling (in millimeters) before structural collapse occurs. S_max = 2 * c' / gamma.
